title: 司法・犯罪心理学
subtitle: Forensic and Criminal Psychology
keywords: Criminal and justice procedures 2.Investigation, justice, correction, and rehabilitation 3.Family court 4.Aggressor support, Victum support 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Judicial and criminal psychology is the study of psychology in judicial proceedings related to crimes, etc. Judicial and criminal psychology is a discipline that studies and practices the use of psychological knowledge and techniques in judicial proceedings related to crimes. Students will learn the roles of psychological professionals in this field and the way psychology should be used by grasping the laws and systems of criminal and juvenile justice and understanding the work and cooperation of related institutions and facilities.
advice: The lecture will focus on the laws and regulations of criminal and juvenile justice, the system, and the work of related institutions and facilities, while introducing the atmosphere of the field based on my experience working at the Family Court. The lecture will focus on the laws and systems of criminal and juvenile justice, and the work of related institutions and facilities.

activityGoals.body: Understand the trends and current status of crime and delinquency.
Provide an overview of criminal justice procedures and related institutions.
Provide an overview of juvenile justice procedures and related institutions.
To be able to give an overview of domestic affairs cases (cases involving family disputes, etc.).
To be able to explain the role of psychological professionals and psychology in the fields of justice and crime.
